accepted_baseline.label: Five-scene monumental Spaces engine
preserve: Map 5 strict maximum two visible signs

current_candidate.summary: Spaces v25 corrects the Map 5 spatial relationship: one elevated central bridge/path at Y=-1.12, finite edges, and no lateral horizontal floor. Violet columns sit immediately outside the bridge edges, extend from Y=-38 to Y=42/50, remain absolutely black through the deepest lower section, and become progressively lighter violet upward. Visible vertical bridge edge faces make it clear that the camera path is above the column bases. Hidden-hinge signs and the max-two scheduler are preserved.

open_feedback: Verify the camera path reads as an elevated central bridge between the columns, not as a shared floor.
Verify there is no lateral floor beneath the columns.
Verify column bases disappear into absolute black and upper shafts become clearly violet.
Verify columns appear directly beside the path and continue far above the frame.
Verify signs still hide behind columns and no more than two are visible.
